MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly for trial by jury.

Appearances:
DANIEL BORNSTEIN, Esq. on behalf of plaintiff Bernstein Realty, Inc.
HANNAH S. PETERS, Esq. on behalf of Defendant Claudia Juestel (aka Claudia Adetuyi)

The parties reached a settlement after being sent to Judge Pro Tem. Terms of the settlement are as follows: Defendant to relinquish property situated at 940 Leavenworth St., Unit 1, San Francisco, CA. on or before April 30, 2006. Upon vacating the premises, plaintiff to give to defendant the sum of $30,000.00. CC 1542 waiver was put on the record. Security deposit is declared forfeited. Plaintiff reserves to persue damages claim. All parties agreed to this settlement.
